name: Vietnam National Fine Arts Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật Việt Nam
summary: Walk the galleries of the Vietnam National Fine Arts Museum at 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc, a short walk from the Temple of Literature. Open to the public since 1966, it keeps about 2,000 works on display from a collection of nearly 20,000. Pair it with the temple courtyards for one unhurried morning in Ba Dinh.
getThere: Walk from the Temple of Literature
heroCaption: The exterior of the Fine Arts Museum
body: The museum is at 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Ba Dinh, a short walk from the Temple of Literature. It opened to the public in 1966. About 2,000 works are on display, drawn from a collection of nearly 20,000.
Do the temple courtyards first, then walk over for the galleries. It is a quieter morning than the lake, and an easy one to add to the temple.

figures.caption: A gallery room inside the museum
figures.alt: A gallery inside the Vietnam National Fine Arts Museum

gettingThere: 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Ba Dinh. Walk from the Temple of Literature, or take a car or motorbike from Hoan Kiem.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. The museum pages list no fee or hours.
